I could not run a transport code here, so this sample was generated by hand from analytic cross-section proportions and two-body kinematics, not by an executed Monte Carlo simulation. The events are kinematically consistent, but the sample is approximate and the counts are not a statistical draw.

Expected mix: about 98.5% Compton, about 1% pair (primary photons only), about 0.5% Rayleigh, and photoelectric negligible. Primary and scattered interactions are roughly balanced at 5 cm depth.
